   - Asymmetrical bitemporal hyperintensities are indicative of brain lesions, often seen in infections affecting the temporal lobes.

   - Swimming in freshwater and spelunking increase the risk of exposure to Naegleria fowleri, a free-living amoeba that causes PAM.
